options:

For each option, if abs(s_c - e_c) == row_diff: take it.

start_r = upper['max_r'], start_c = s_c, end_c = e_c.
dy = 1 if end_c > start_c else -1.
for i in 1..row_diff-1: nr=start_r+i, nc=start_c+i*dy; output[nr][nc]=color.
